articles.summary: Slipway is an open-source, self-hosted platform purpose-built for Sails.js and The Boring JavaScript Stack. Deploy, manage, monitor, and debug your apps on your own infrastructure with one command.
articles.title: Introducing Slipway - The Complete Deployment Platform for Sails.js & The Boring JavaScript Stack

articles.summary: When you hear real-time in Sails, you think WebSockets. But there's another way — Server-Sent Events. Here's how I went from polling to SSE to a custom Sails hook in Slipway, and when you should use each.
articles.title: Real-Time with SSE the Sails Way

articles.summary: Your AI writes the component. But does it survive a refresh? Durable UI is a new Sailscasts course that teaches the state placement decisions no LLM can make for you.
articles.title: Introducing Durable UI: The 30% That Vibe Coding Can't Teach You

articles.summary: Durable UI is a set of patterns for building interfaces that survive refreshes, navigation, and real users. A practical guide to state placement, cleanup contracts, and UI that doesn't break.
articles.title: Durable UI Patterns
